description: This file defines the 'ToString' class, which implements a method operation for the mini-language in OFBiz. It provides functionality for converting a specified field into a string with optional formatting and numeric padding, used within the mini-language's simple methods.

classes.name: ToString
classes.description: Implements a mini-language operation that converts a specified field to a string with optional formatting and padding.

classes.name: ToStringFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the ToString operation.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ToString operation based on XML element attributes, validating attributes and parsing parameters.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the to-string operation: retrieves the field value, applies formatting and padding, and updates the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ToString object, mainly for debugging.

methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ToString from XML element.
